items.title: The Golden Palace
items.description: The Golden Palace is an American sitcom television series produced as a sequel to The Golden Girls without Bea Arthur, that originally aired on CBS from September 1992 to May 1993. Not as popular as its predecessor, the series aired for a single 24-episode season and was cancelled by CBS.
